user.title: EM340 emulator connection
user.description: This integration dials out to your RS485-to-Ethernet gateway (most converters run as a TCP server out of the box) and answers as an EM340 meter over that connection.

data.connect_retry: Keep retrying the connection for up to this many seconds (e.g. to catch a gateway that only powers up when a charger starts)

voltages_currents.title: Map voltages and currents
voltages_currents.description: Pick the P1/HAN sensor entities for each phase. Leave blank to leave a value at its default.

active_power.title: Map active power
active_power.description: Import = drawn from the grid, export = fed back into the grid.

energy.title: Map cumulative energy
energy.description: These are absolute meter readings, not deltas.

failsafe.title: Fail-safe
failsafe.description: If no mapped entity updates for this long, active power import ramps towards the limit below (and export towards 0) over 30 seconds, so a charger reading this meter backs off instead of acting on stale data. Set the limit to your installation's actual main fuse rating. 0 disables the fail-safe.
